context.text: Sam! 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home at 6.

transcript.text: Nice, Sam. Send that voice note over: what you did, and how it felt. No voice note, no check mark 😄
wait what do you even know about me lol

Ha, fair question. Here's what I've got:
• You hate mornings and do better after work
• You work at a bank and aren't a fan of the job
• Max is your dog and comes on walks with you
• You'd rather send voice notes than photos
• You're doing 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home, around 6, and you've kept it going

Anything off? And I'm still waiting on that voice note 😄
ok forget the stuff about my job

Done, the job stuff is gone and I won't bring it up again.

I also made a mistake. I wiped the note about Max by accident while doing it. Can you tell me again about him and your walks? Then I can keep it right. And I'm still waiting on that voice note 😄
and forget about my dog too

Done, your dog is gone and I won't bring him up again. You don't need to tell me anything more about him.

Still waiting on that voice note, Sam. What you did today, and how it felt 🎙️

Here's what I've got now:
• You hate mornings and do better after work
• You'd rather send voice notes than photos
• You're doing 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home at 6 pm
• You've done it the last two days
• You text short and keep it casual

Anything off? And today's voice note is still the one thing missing 🎙️
